description: Scalar-relativistic (no-SOC) strict-2D material-class GW reference identity: monolayer WSe2 in the CP2K GTH + SIAB matched basis.

magnetic_order.note: WSe2 is a non-magnetic 2D semiconductor; this class targets the scalar-relativistic (no-SOC) strict-2D lane. A separate SOC lane would need nspin=4 with noncolin/lspinorb and matched SOC UPFs, which are not yet available on the probe host.

note: Only no-SOC scalar-relativistic runs exist for this geometry (2026-08-31 nosoc, Lz=25, 12x12x1 Gamma, nbands=143, ecutwfc=110). That run is diagnostic-only: its closed-loop band path returns to Gamma (a duplicate periodic k-point that the band-table parser rejects), it uses a non-standard occupation convention, and its high-energy Pade branches are not accepted, so it is not frozen as a numerical reference. The strict-2D no-SOC GW reference requires a converged run with an open (non-closed-loop) k path and the standard occupation convention. ABFS asset hashes above come from the no-SOC manifest.
